assertion_audit.fails_if: The held-input fixture does not release or the pending derivation never enters its input; these are fixture controls, not product guards.
The initial fresh prompt returns an error instead of establishing the pre-retention digest.
The station/export branch is wrong, a live heartbeat is classified stale, or retained-answer freshness is absent; answer_stale is independently required true while heartbeat stale is false.
Reading mutates the stored 180-second marker or fails to advance the returned age to 200 seconds; removing reader-time age recomputation makes the second assertion fail.
Removing the retained header warning or freezing its age removes stale or 3m20s from the independently clocked expected prompt; the reverse-patch receipt demonstrates this failure.
The prompt errors or retains the previous fresh digest and suppresses entering retention; removing retention identity from reading suppresses the nonempty case.
A live station is offered the stopped-station restart command.
The prompt drops the retained duty or suppresses an explicitly stale empty answer; the supplied run id is an output-preservation expectation, not an equality that survives arbitrary product behavior.
The second prompt errors or emits the same retained answer again after a one-second age advance; including age_seconds in the digest would redden the silence assertion.

The worker remains pending, the post-refresh prompt errors, or the nonempty fresh list is suppressed or still labelled stale; retaining the retention digest across completion fails the transition guard.
Completion leaves the stored stale marker or reader answer_stale true; returning answer_stale as a constant true fails the final assertion.

assertion_independence: No newly added assertion compares a returned value to a self-moving echo; literal elapsed ages, independently selected source and preservation of fixture duty identity each name a regression that fails.
